subject: Closure checkpoint: final certification, signer order, and Day-0 kickoff alignment
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@avaretail.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + final checklist for go/no-go and Day-0 kickoff

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is the MAP_v3.pdf (condensed) which captures the commit steps we discussed. To keep the final close tidy, can we align on the following checkpoints this week?

1) Approval ladder: legal sign-off (Ava counsel) -> procurement PO acceptance -> exec go/ok from Elliot -> Redwood e-sign.
2) Signature window: staggered DocuSign order so procurement (Elliot/procurement@avaretail.com) signs first, Ava exec signs next; target e-sign completion by Thu 24 Jul EOD PT.
3) Evidence: we attached SOC2_section_excerpt.pdf — please confirm if you need more artifacts for your security review.
4) Start date (Day-0): we propose Mon 28 Jul as onboarding Day-0 with a 2-hour kickoff (US PT friendly). If that date doesn't work, propose an alternate the week of 28 Jul.

Quick asks:
- Can Elliot confirm the PO cadence and whether procurement will need a PO template filled (we included PO_template.xlsx)?
- Priyom, could you confirm the signer order and any legal holdbacks we should bake into the DocuSign envelope?

If we can lock the signer order and PO by Thursday EOD, Camila will hold the Day-0 slot and prep the onboarding runbook.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0134

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (summary), SOC2_section_excerpt.pdf, PO_template.xlsx

From: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@avaretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elliot Barnes <elliot.barnes@avaretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@avaretail.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + final checklist for go/no-go and Day-0 kickoff

Sean —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick notes from our side:

- Procurement: Elliot confirms they'll use your PO_template.xlsx but need it converted to our internal reference format (we'll return within 24 hours).
- Security: SOC2 excerpt is fine for now; security wants the full CC2 appendix for the audit trail. I'll have our security contact loop you in if needed.
- Signature order: procurement manager (procurement@avaretail.com) should sign first, then our CFO (Elliot) for dollar authority, then Bella (VP Product) for project acceptance. Can we add Bella to the envelope?
- Day-0: tentative OK for 28 Jul, but our exec wants the kickoff scheduled at 10:00 PT to accommodate east coast stakeholders.

If procurement returns the formatted PO by Wed morning and legal doesn't request edits, we should meet your Thu EOD sign target. I'll circle back after Elliot confirms the PO timing.

Thanks —
Maya Thompson
Head of Integrations | Ava Retail
maya.thompson@avaretail.com

Sean / Camila —

Thanks for the heads-up. From a legal perspective:

- DocuSign envelope: we should configure signer authentication (email + SMS) for the CFO and VP Product signers due to contract value.
- Signature order: procurement first, CFO second, VP Product third — that's fine. Add Bella's full name and email (please confirm).
- Standard redlines: none anticipated in MAP_v3; if Ava's counsel proposes changes, flag them immediately and we'll run a 24-hr rapid review.
- Start date: we prefer the contract to state the start-of-service as the date of final signature but operational Day-0 kickoff on 28 Jul is fine to include as "planned onboarding" in the SOW.

I'll prepare the envelope template and share the DocuSign link once Maya confirms the full signer list.

– Priyom Das
